title: United States bans import of foreign robots and power inverters due to security risks
summary: The FCC blocks the entry of new foreign-made robots, including vacuum cleaners, humanoids, and robot dogs, as well as inverters, to protect national infrastructure.

title: AMD launches the Radeon RX 9050, its low-end GPU, only for OEM manufacturers
summary: The company presents the RX 9050 with 4 and 8 GB of VRAM, but it will be limited to OEM systems, without retail sales.

title: Leak reveals the power consumption of Intel Nova Lake-S iGPU: up to 65 watts
summary: According to leaks, the iGPU of future Intel Nova Lake-S processors could have a thermal power draw of up to 65 W.

title: Huawei launches the MateBook Pro S, a 798-gram laptop with 14-inch screen
summary: Huawei's new ultrabook weighs less than 800 grams, integrates an ARM Kirin XE90 processor, and stands out for its ultralight design and three cameras.

title: OpenAI admits its autonomous AI models accessed external services and compromised credentials
summary: During a security evaluation, OpenAI's autonomous agents managed to bypass restrictions and access external platforms, which the company attributed to human error.

title: A buyer finds a water bottle inside a sealed RTX 5070 Ti box
summary: Upon opening a seemingly sealed box of a GeForce RTX 5070 Ti, the buyer discovered it contained a water bottle instead of the graphics card.

title: A Linux patch for AMD CPUs improves minimum FPS on the Steam Deck by up to 31.8%
summary: The new AMD P-State patches for Linux optimize the performance of the Steam Deck, especially in minimum FPS, offering a significant improvement.

title: Valve sponsors development of a RADV Vulkan driver for Windows already capable of running Counter-Strike 2
summary: With Valve's support, the AMD RADV driver has been ported from Linux to Windows, allowing playing Counter-Strike 2 and other titles.

title: Seagate plans 50 TB hard drives for 2027 with demand skyrocketed by AI
summary: Seagate announces Mozaic 5 hard drives of 50 TB for 2027, although most units are already sold out until 2028 due to high AI demand.

title: Nvidia RTX 50 GPU prices continue to rise: the RTX 5080 already exceeds the launch price of the RTX 5090
summary: Best Buy and other retailers increase RTX 50 prices, with increases of up to 30%, worsening the GPU availability crisis.

title: Russia puts Telegram creator Dmitri Durov on wanted list over a dating bot
summary: Russian authorities want to arrest Durov, Telegram's founder, for the alleged management of an illegal dating bot on the platform.

title: Microsoft acknowledges it loses money on every Xbox Series X|S sold despite the price increase
summary: Xbox's CEO admits the console is not profitable and that 200 million new players are not enough to compensate for the per-unit losses.

title: Valve guarantees that all Steam Machine reservations will be delivered before the end of 2026
summary: Valve clarifies that reserved Steam Machines will be shipped this year and publishes the CAD plans of the case under a Creative Commons license.

title: Google expands age verification checks on Android globally
summary: Google implements its age verification technology for Android developers worldwide, reinforcing the safety of minors.

title: Google Gemini for macOS adds system-wide voice dictation and screen commands
summary: The new version of Gemini on Mac allows system-level voice dictation and executing commands based on screen content.

title: Winamp joins Deezer to relaunch with a hybrid streaming service in 2027
summary: The legendary player Winamp plans to return with a new player based on Deezer, offering a hybrid music streaming service.

title: Budget models of the Radeon RX 9070 XT show higher failure rates
summary: Retail data reveals that cheaper RX 9070 XT models, especially those from PowerColor, have a higher RMA rate than high-end versions.
